unit.why: A single anecdote: R. Mordechai Leitner, the disciple, overhears an invisible voice teaching his master R. Zvi Hirsh of Zydaczow at night, and later learns from his master that the voice was the Ari.

stories.start_quote: סיפר תלמידו הגאוה״ק ר׳ מרדכי לעטניר זצ"ל
stories.end_quote: מי הי׳ אותו הקול ששמע בלילה
stories.summary_en: R. Mordechai Leitner, sleeping beside his master R. Zvi Hirsh's room, hears at night an unseen voice explaining a Zohar passage to him; at the next Third Meal he hears the same homily from his master, who ends 'thus I heard from the mouth of the Ari', and he understands whose voice it was.

quotes: שמע קול מדבר אל רבו פירוש על מאמר מזוה״ק
ולא ראה שם שום אדם רק שמע הקול מדבר
